channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gerald Wallace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gerald Wallace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
“He then tore his ACL, that’s when he didn’t play, but he was playing when I was there. He was playing like 30 minutes a game. Gerald Wallace had to force him to take a shower one time. Had to force him. Imagine that. Imagine forcing a grown man to take a shower. He should be ashamed of himself.”

Jared Dudley on Gerald Wallace, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Evan Turner on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Tom Halzack:Evan Turner on last season:

“We pretty much had Gerald Wallace cursing us out if we didn't play defense.”

Evan Turner on Gerald Wallace, Jul 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @TomHalzack.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Marcus Smart on Gerald Wallace:

“He never sugarcoated anything, and that's what you want, as a player trying to develop.”

Marcus Smart on Gerald Wallace, Jul 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Smart on Wallace:

“I think Gerald’s been in the league for — I forgot how long, but Gerald’s old. Gerald is a grandfather in this league.”

Marcus Smart on Gerald Wallace, Jul 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Avery Bradley on Gerald Wallace:

“I’m happy that he’s on my team and I have somebody that goes as hard as he does.”

Avery Bradley on Gerald Wallace, Mar 31, 2015. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
“I’m not too worried about chemistry in the locker room, and large credit for that goes to Gerald Wallace,”

Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace, Jan 17, 2015. Source: WEEI.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Stevens:

“You don't have to be named Captain to be a leader. Gerald Wallace is a loud voice who has a lot of impact.”

Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace, Jan 5, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Nicolas Batum, Gerald Wallace
item.description:
It’s one of the only things he regrets during his time as the Trail Blazers coach.

“Really, I felt like Nicolas was going to be a good player and a talented player. Again, he was drafted with that in mind, with being a part of the future. Probably the one thing when I look back on my time in Portland that I regret was the decision to take Nicolas out of that lineup and starting Gerald Wallace,”

Nate McMillan on Nicolas Batum, Gerald Wallace, Nov 27, 2013. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
“I told Gerald this … I thought (Sullinger and Olynyk), with their ability to pass and stretch the floor, would open up some driving lanes for him and some plays for him,”

Brad Stevens on Gerald Wallace, Nov 7, 2013. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Jason Kidd:

“I think there's a lot more that Gerald (Wallace) brings to the table. As an ex-player, seeing him on the floor with the things that he causes on the defense, what he gives the opponents. So I think he has has a lot more to give and my job is to get him to that level that I think he should be.”

Jason Kidd on Gerald Wallace, Jun 19, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: PJ Carlesimo on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets coachP.J. Carlesimo said before Game 4 of the first-round matchup with the Chicago Bulls that he hasn't read Friday's comments from a disappointed Gerald Wallace, but that the issue has still been addressed.

“I didn't see [Wallace's comments] to be honest with you, but I've talked to Gerald and hopefully we've done a better job of letting Gerald know the things that are important for him to do to help us be successful,”

PJ Carlesimo on Gerald Wallace, Apr 27, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
“The play was over when he (Wallace) started. I was just trying to make sure he was safe; that was it. I don't know where in America where you can jack somebody's pants off or shorts ... I don't know what the hell was going on.”

Kevin Garnett on Gerald Wallace, Dec 26, 2012. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Billy King on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Billy King on Gerald Wallace, who has a player option, but has publicly said he wants to return to the Nets next season:

“We've had conversations with his representatives because actually we can talk about the potential of [an] extension if he opts in. We'll leave that there.”

Billy King on Gerald Wallace, May 20, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Gerald Wallace
item.description:
Artest said,

“I guess, maybe. I don't know. I'm a physical player so that just feels normal to me. If (Gerald Wallace) wants to feel good about that, good for him.”

Metta World Peace on Gerald Wallace, Apr 9, 2011. Source: Oregonian.
